meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跟着引导完成首次配置,顺畅跑通核心工作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触这个工具,想快速知道从哪一步开始。
copy.tagline_en: Walk through first-time setup and get the core workflow running
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to this tool and unsure where to begin.

howto.what: 它会当新用户首次使用 omo 的向导，按顺序走六条通道（功能导览、迁移帮助、会话考古等），用你的语言和口吻回复，并把了解到的持久信息写进记忆。
howto.when: 当新用户提出想开始使用 omo 时触发。它只自动启动一次，之后可用 `omo --onboard` 或 `senpi --onboard` 调回。

say.text: 我是第一次用 omo，带我走一遍入门流程。
say.note: 启动六条通道的首次引导。

say.text: 我原来用 Claude Code，帮我把配置迁过来。
say.note: 进入迁移通道，先给方案等你确认。

say.text: 翻一下我过去的会话记录，估算 omo 缓存能省多少。
say.note: 驱动会话考古与价值映射估算。

howto.what_en: It guides a new omo user through six lanes (feature tour, migration help, session analysis, and more), replies in the user's own language and tone, and records durable facts via the memory tools.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo. It auto-starts only once; users can bring it back later with `omo --onboard` or `senpi --onboard`.

say_en.text: I'm new to omo — walk me through the onboarding flow.
I came from Claude Code; carry my setup over.
say_en.note: Runs migration and shows a plan to accept.

say_en.text: Look through my past sessions and estimate omo's cache savings.
say_en.note: Drives session archaeology and value mapping.
